title: The Girl Who Drank the Moon
author: Kelly Barnhill
current_text: Escambia County Public Schools in Florida pulled The Girl Who Drank the Moon from its shelves to review it for sexual content.

sources.quote: Minneapolis author Kelly Barnhill, whose book The Girl Who Drank the Moon was pulled from the shelves in Escambia County Public Schools in Florida to review for sexual content.
